title: Machine-learned dependency map identifies PAPSS1/PAPSS2 synthetic lethality in cancer
summary: TCGA DEPMAP was built by machine learning of gene essentiality in the Cancer Dependency Map and translated to TCGA patients. Exploratory analyses nominated PAPSS1 dependency driven by loss of PAPSS2, which is collaterally deleted with PTEN; the synthetic lethality was validated in vitro and in vivo, and patients with predicted PAPSS1/2 synthetic lethality had worse overall survival. Validation covers one synthetic-lethal pair of a largely resource-type map. Preprint v1 of 2022-03-27.
ai_technology: Machine learning models of gene essentiality trained on DepMap and translated to TCGA tumors

evidence.tested: In vitro and in vivo validation of PAPSS1/PAPSS2 synthetic lethality and its mechanism; survival association in TCGA patients.
evidence.unknown: Validity of other predicted dependencies in the map is not established; abstract-level review; full text not reviewed.
evidence.ai_role: Machine learning of gene essentiality produced the dependency map from which the PAPSS1/2 pair was nominated.
